# 太子墓魄經

**ID:** T0168
**Volume:** T03
**Category:** 本緣部類
**Original Category:** 本緣部
**Byline:** 西晉 竺法護譯
**Dynasty:** 西晉
**Date:** 266–313
**Juans:** 1
**CBETA:** https://cbetaonline.dila.edu.tw/zh/T0168

## Contributors
- 竺法護 (A000749)

## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A short single-fascicle Western-Jìn *jātaka* recounting the past life of the Buddha as Prince Mùpò 墓魄 — the same narrative as [安世高](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%AE%89%E4%B8%96%E9%AB%98) Ān Shìgāo's earlier *[T167 Tàizǐ Mùpò jīng](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6b/KR6b0019)*, with a different opening orthography of the prince's name (墓魄 / 慕魄, both transliterations of *Mūka* / *Mūga*). Translated by [竺法護](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E7%AB%BA%E6%B3%95%E8%AD%B7) Dharmarakṣa in the late third / early fourth century. Signature: 「西晉月氏國三藏竺法護譯」. The Taishō head-note records: 「沐魄或慕魄」 ("[the *Kāi-yuán-lù*] notes the orthographic variant 沐魄 / 慕魄").

The Taishō header cross-references [T152(38)](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6b/KR6b0001) and [T167](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6b/KR6b0019).

**Abstract**

T168 is the second-stage translation of the *Mūgapakkha-jātaka* into Chinese, succeeding [安世高](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%AE%89%E4%B8%96%E9%AB%98) Ān Shìgāo's [T167](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6b/KR6b0019) by some 120 years. The doublet relationship is acknowledged in the canonical cross-reference. The translation is dateable to Dharmarakṣa's documented Cháng'ān-period activity (c. 285–311 CE), within his late-third-century prolific period. The Chinese translation idiom of T168 is markedly more polished than T167 and shows the editorial maturation that distinguishes the Western-Jìn translation school from the Hàn-period archaic register; comparison of T167 / T168 / T152 chapter 38 has been one of the standard case-studies in Boucher's and Nattier's analyses of pre-Kumārajīva Chinese Buddhist translation idiom.
